Method of Attack: SMB worm spreading ransomware on local network and Internet
Use of kill switch domain to stop encryption
Exploitation of modified NSA SMB exploit
Use of hardcoded kill switch domain as anti-sandboxing protection
Impacted Systems: Vulnerable computers on local networks and Internet
Nearly half of infected computers located in Russia
Attack Vector: Hardcoded kill switch domain ping before encryption
Indicators of Compromise: First kill switch domain discovered and registered by MalwareTech
Second kill switch domain registered by Matt Suiche
WannaDecrypt utility by Benjamin Delpy for file recovery if private RSA key is dumped
